text: APPROVE. The nested loop body moves unchanged into `AddGoEmbedRef`, with each `continue` correctly becoming a `return`, so behaviour is preserved. The extracted branching and ternary no longer count toward `CollectGoEmbedRefs`, which should bring it under 15, and the new private static method should not introduce build warnings. I could not see the top of the method, so I assumed `rel`, `directory` and `hostEmbeds` are typed `string`, `string` and `List<HostEmbedRef>`.
